title: Kinetic: Break All Limits
description:
Your speed is your power. Leap, dash, and slash your way to victory in this 2D Speedrunner platformer that blends the lightning speed of Sonic, the striking style of Metroid, and the intense combat of Mega Man. As Kin, you'll equip a cutting-edge suit and race to save your world from a mysterious alien invasion. 
 
In the all-new Arcade Mode, you'll strategically unlock new powers the faster you go, turning a desperate sprint into a showcase of skill and speed. The desperate sprint is only the beginning of your journey to break your limits. 

Key Features

 

Leap, dash, and slash through intricate environments with pixel-perfect precision.

Unlock a dynamic arsenal of abilities that change how you approach every challenge.

  

Climb the ranks and compete against the world's best in Trials Mode. 

_____________________________________________________________________________

A Word from the Developers
Kinetic: Break All Limits is the culmination of years of passionate dedication from our small team of three developers. We've poured our hearts and souls into building this game, even crafting a custom engine in C++ from the ground up to achieve the precise responsiveness and visual style we envisioned for Kinetic's high-speed gameplay. With a world of possibilities at your fingertips and the power to choose your path, it's up to you to break your limits and become the hero your planet needs.
description_short: Fast, fluid, and exhilarating. Jump, dash, bounce, and swing through a world of freedom. There is nothing holding you back. Destroy enemies with your energy blasts as you race to the finish, fight friends online, or free your home planet from an invasive menace in adventure mode!
